name: Yama Bunkatsu Forest
description: It a place full of dangers, especially the four Oni Guardians, typically forcing any reason for attacking. Blue Oni. Guardian of the trees and other plants. Red Oni. Guardian of animals and wildlife. Wet Oni. Guardian of streams and waterfalls Mountain Oni. Guardian of treasures and gems Many adventurers are hired to get their herbs and explore treasures of the forest, as some sugenjas believe another angelic artifact is hidden within Yama Bunkatsu.
